# EntityShininess

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EntityShininess:Void entity:Int32, shininess:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | Entity handle. |
| `shininess` | In | Float32 | required | Strength of the highlight, 0 to 1. |

## Description

Sets how strongly lights shine back from the entity as highlights. 0, the default, is matt. Values near 1 give a polished look, like a billiard ball, but only where a light hits the surface head on.
